description: A page heading above the drawing reads "Diagram 2.30 Wall type 3.3 with independent composite panels", and the drawing is identified as a SECTION by a label in the lower right corner. It shows a vertical section comprising four separate vertical members arranged in a row with visible gaps between them. At the far left is a narrow vertical strip filled with fine horizontal shading. To its right, after a gap, stands a wider vertical column built from a stack of four rectangular segments, each enclosed by a border and filled with a diagonal cross-hatch pattern (an X of two lines). A further gap separates this column from a second, similar wider column of stacked cross-hatched rectangular segments, of which three are shown. At the far right, after a final gap, is a second narrow vertical strip, also filled with horizontal shading, mirroring the left-hand strip. No dimensions or scale appear within the drawing. The outer narrow strips and the two inner cross-hatched columns are each depicted as distinct, non-touching elements.
